cardOverview.overviewText: A financial inclusion card created to support underserved users, offering essential rewards, fee waivers, and digital-first features for easy credit access.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: The BoB Swavlamban Credit Cardholders get insurance coverage against personal accidental death. Moreover, card liability protection is also offered in case of unauthorized transactions made through your credit card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Bank of Baroda Customer Care at 1800 22 5100 and for email support, contact crm@bobfinancial.com
